Follow-up push to this PR: the staticcheck check flagged `input/system/planetscale/logs.go:108:3` (SA4004, "the surrounding loop is unconditionally terminated"). Now that the decode-error path returns instead of `continue`, every path in `Read()` exits on the first iteration, so the `for` loop is removed. No behaviour change.

AI disclosure: this change was prepared with the assistance of an AI coding agent.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
